    "llm_reasoning": "Node.js is single-threaded. Using fs.readFileSync blocks the entire event loop while waiting for disk I/O. Under load, this will cause the server to stop processing all other incoming requests until the file read completes, leading to severe latency spikes and poor scalability.",
    "suggested_fix": "Use the asynchronous version of the file system API: fs.promises.readFile(filePath, 'utf8').then(data => res.send(data)).catch(err => res.status(500).send(err));",
